textbookBox.concept: In a lush forest lived an old stag who was known for his kindness. Each day he warmly greeted his fellow animals and birds.

beats.en: In a lush forest lived an old stag who was known for his kindness. Each day he warmly greeted his fellow animals and birds.
beats.speakEn: In a lush forest lived an old stag who was known for his kindness. Each day he warmly greeted his fellow animals and birds.

beats.en: One day the stag fell ill and struggled to reach the hillock. He knew that fresh healthy food and proper rest would help him get well, so he ate the tender grass and rested.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 english · The Old Stag · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Before leaving, the visitors ate some of the fresh green grass on the hillock and said how tender and juicy it was. Word spread, and every animal who came to visit the stag also feasted on the grass.

beats.en: Before leaving, the visitors ate some of the fresh green grass on the hillock and said how tender and juicy it was. Word spread, and every animal who came to visit the stag also feasted on the grass.
beats.speakEn: Before leaving, the visitors ate some of the fresh green grass on the hillock and said how tender and juicy it was. Word spread, and every animal who came to visit the stag also feasted on the grass.

beats.en: His friends felt ashamed when they realised their mistake. They decided to find food elsewhere in the forest and not disturb the hillock, and some brought fresh leaves for him.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 english · The Old Stag · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Lush means green and thick, like a lush forest. Tender means soft and young, like tender grass. A hillock is a small hill. A stag is a male deer.

beats.en: Let us review the key takeaway from The Old Stag: Lush means green and thick, like a lush forest. Tender means soft and young, like tender grass. A hillock is a small hill. A stag is a male deer.
